title: No global exception handling: any unhandled error kills the app with no log and no state flush
existing_state: Program.Main (Program.cs:13-60) calls Application.Run(new Form1()) at Program.cs:59 with no try/catch, and a repo-wide search for Application.ThreadException, AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException, TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException, and SetUnhandledExceptionMode returns zero hits in any .cs file. The shell is a 15,360-line Form1.cs plus async void handlers (e.g. Form1_Shown at Form1.cs:414) wired to an SSH engine, a cron scheduler, and WebView2 bridges. Today any stray exception on the UI thread shows the stock .NET crash dialog, and one on a worker/Task thread silently terminates the process — unsaved host-grid edits (_csvDirty state), running executions, and the active scheduler all die with zero diagnostics written anywhere. ScintillaNativeBootstrap.ConfigureSatelliteDirectory (Program.cs:58) can itself throw InvalidOperationException pre-UI (ScintillaNativeBootstrap.cs:84-86) and is equally unhandled.
recommendation: In Program.Main, before Application.Run: call Application.SetUnhandledExceptionMode(UnhandledExceptionMode.CatchException), subscribe Application.ThreadException, AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException, and TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException. The shared handler should append exception + stack to a crash log under AppDataPaths.GetAppFolder() (e.g. crash.log), show a themed 'unexpected error' dialog with the log path, and on fatal paths attempt a best-effort SaveApplicationState/config flush before exit. Also wrap the ConfigureSatelliteDirectory call so a Scintilla extraction failure produces a message instead of a pre-UI hard crash.
user_benefit: Bugs stop costing users their unsaved fleet edits and their scheduler session, and every crash leaves a log you can actually debug from instead of a one-off 'it just closed' report.

evidence.note: Main has no exception handling; Application.Run(new Form1()) bare at :59
throws InvalidOperationException when both extraction roots are unwritable — unhandled pre-UI
async void Form1_Shown — exceptions escaping it crash the process
